data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 frames the neighbourhood incompatibility as a relation between SRC_002 and SRC_004, then asserts that SRC_004 reduces to SRC_002 iff P-tractability implies Q-unification. But a conditional reduction (A reduces to B iff P→Q) is not a substantive reduction claim; it is a tautological restatement of the incompatibility the target already described. The problem context requires naming a substantive relation kind and stating what it is refuted if. Here the 'reduction' is entirely hostage to an unestablished implication, so the target asserts no actual dependence, reduction, or integration between the artifacts — only a logical conditional whose truth value is left open. The target therefore fails to propose a genuine relation: it restates the endpoints' threshold mismatch under a reduction label, which the problem context explicitly excludes ('a summary of the endpoints is not a relation').
